name: inventory-slot-clicks
comment: WP-2.5. Container.slotClick on the player's ContainerPlayer (slots: 0 the 2x2 output, 1-4 the grid, 5-8 armour helmet first, 9-35 main inventory, 36-44 hotbar). A player (id 0) on a stone floor next to a workbench; each use_item puts a stack into hotbar slot 0 (currentItem) and right-clicks the workbench, whose blockActivated returns true, so the stack is not used. One op per tick from t=1: 20 cobblestone picked up (left) and put into slot 9; 30 more, half picked up with a right click ((30+1)/2 = 15) and merged into slot 9; the larger half of slot 9 picked up (18) and placed one by one with right clicks into slot 10; 5 sticks swapped with the held cobblestone (the cursor stack and the slot exchange) and put into slot 11; a diamond helmet refused by the chestplate slot (6, SlotArmor.isItemValid), accepted by the helmet slot (5, limit 1); sticks refused by the leggings slot (7); 3 logs into the grid (result 4 planks); the result picked up into an empty hand (SlotCrafting.onPickupFromSlot: one log consumed, the result recomputed), then onto the held planks (the output branch: whole stack onto a matching held stack), then shift-clicked (ContainerPlayer.getStackInSlot: mergeItemStack 9..45 from the end, into hotbar slot 8); two planks placed with right clicks in a column (result 4 sticks), shift-clicked onto the 5 sticks in slot 11 (mergeItemStack's top-up pass); shift-clicks main -> hotbar, hotbar -> main (top-up of slot 10), helmet -> main; held planks merged into hotbar slot 8; the helmet picked up with a right click ((1+1)/2) and swapped twice with slot 10's cobblestone; the helmet back on. The inventory dump (36 + 4 slots, cursor stack, the 2x2 grid and result) after every tick; rng_state at the end.
